name: Robin
description: Multi-agent system that automates scientific discovery steps such as literature review and candidate proposal.
whatItDoes: Proposes experimental assays and therapeutic candidates for a disease by combining literature-search agents with LLM reasoning. It is for scientists exploring hypotheses in biomedicine.
howItWorks: A notebook-driven workflow calls hosted literature agents on the Edison platform, then uses an LLM to rank and justify hypotheses. It is run through the robin_demo.ipynb notebook in Jupyter, locally or in a Docker container, and the Python module can also be imported.

requirements.name: EDISON_API_KEY
requirements.description: Edison platform literature agents (requires purchased credits)
